dboxTimeline.text: The airship, high over Spira. Below, six places the pilgrimage touched have gone dark at once.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Someone is calling them. All of them, all at once.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Calling. Forcing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: The same shapes as yours, Yuna. Wrong colours.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yevon has kept its acolytes. They need no temple for this.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Six of them, ya? One for every road we walked

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Then we walk them again, and send each one home.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Start where it started. Besaid

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Alright. An old friend, then. A bad one.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Her fury is full. Send someone ahead of you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: One.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: The next is in the desert, where Home stood.
The Sanubia desert, by the ruins of Home.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: He hit me back every single time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Then you learned.
The Thunder Plains. The lightning has not stopped.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Thunder is coming. Do not stand in it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's not all of him, ya.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: No. The storm has a second strike.
The same plains, one flash later.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: He is winding up, ya! Call an aeon!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: He is going home at last.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Slowly.
The road to the Macalania temple, white and quiet.
